name.en: Periodic-He KS-LDA: Gamma, k meshes, basis and SCF

scope.ja: 固定した1原子単純立方Heセル（格子定数4 bohr、価電子2、非偏極LDA_X＋VWN5、局所GTH）。PySCFを使う実行・検証ワークフロー。11設定でk点・Gaussian軌道基底・FFT補助格子・SCFを別々に比較し、Γ／2³は独立DFTK平面波参照と照合。平衡He結晶・完全基底・金属・一般物質は未検証。
scope.en: Fixed one-atom simple-cubic He cell (lattice constant 4 bohr, two valence electrons, unpolarized LDA_X plus VWN5, local GTH). A PySCF execution/validation workflow. Eleven settings separately compare k sampling, Gaussian orbital basis, auxiliary FFT grid and SCF; Gamma and 2³ are compared with independent DFTK plane waves. Equilibrium helium, complete-basis, metals and general materials remain unvalidated.

assumptions.ja: 固定中性セル・2電子閉殻、整数占有。Γ中心の分率k座標と一様重みを保存。同一のGTH係数・Libxc汎関数で独立DFTKと比較し、エネルギー原点のフィットはしない。
assumptions.en: Fixed neutral two-electron closed-shell cell with integer occupations. Explicit Gamma-centered fractional k coordinates and equal weights. Independent DFTK uses identical GTH coefficients and Libxc functionals; no fitted energy shifts.

limits.ja: 不正入力・重なり行列の悪条件・SCF未収束・公差不達を明示して失敗。低い残差だけでk点／基底収束や物理モデルを保証しない。
limits.en: Invalid inputs, excessive overlap conditioning, SCF nonconvergence and missed tolerances fail explicitly. Small residuals alone do not establish k/basis convergence or physical-model accuracy.

reference_note.ja: 別実行のDFTK平面波KS-LDA。Γ／2³で同一モデルを比較し、平面波打切り収束を保存。異なる有限軌道基底のため機械精度一致は要求しない。
reference_note.en: Separately executed DFTK plane-wave KS-LDA at Gamma and 2³ for the same model, with cutoff convergence saved. Different finite orbital bases are compared within a stated tolerance, without machine-precision claims.
